title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: collectDefineValidateFindings module
description: src/define/validate-findings.js exports `collectDefineValidateFindings(tree)`: a pure walker-tree function returning walker-shaped error entries for an interface kind outside INTERFACE_KINDS, an AC description's leading bracketed prefix outside the five known classes, a `tacIds` naming a non-TAC, and an unresolving `ownerRef` or `deliveredBy`. Reuses INTERFACE_KINDS and parseAcClass from src/query/gates.js so the vocabularies cannot diverge. Absence of a bracketed prefix is not a finding (decision 10, kept).
